comment_text: If Jordan was drafted after 2000, either he walks or Chicago trades him before winning. That's what was different back then. Guys wanted to build up the franchise that drafted them. They didn't change teams to chase rings. At least not in their primes.
Bird had a team around him when he got drafted to the Celtics. Chicago drafted and build the team around Jordan. Jordan didn't give up asked for a trade or left to a super team.
